fusions.name: Pressed Into the Ground
fusions.desc: Drops your full weight onto the ground, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Patient Peening
fusions.desc: A short tap that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Anvil Back
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 35% for 12 seconds, and your blunt resistance by 15%.

fusions.name: Struck Back Level
fusions.desc: Every blow you take builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
